D.H: the hero from the reference sheet on deck (Black man in his early thirties, close-cropped black hair, short black beard, navy t-shirt, grey work trousers, black rubber boots)
D.HD: the hero from the reference sheet in his diving gear (Black man in his early thirties, short black beard, black hot-water suit, round yellow commercial diving helmet with a clear faceplate showing his face, orange umbilical hose, black weight harness, black gloves)
D.SUP: the dive supervisor from the reference sheet (white woman in her fifties, grey ponytail, navy cap, red windbreaker, radio headset, clipboard)
D.TEN: the fellow tender from the reference sheet (young Latino man with a thin moustache, grey hoodie, yellow rubber bib overalls, work gloves)
D.INS: the dive-school instructor from the reference sheet (older East Asian man, short grey hair, glasses, white polo shirt, khaki shorts, whistle)
D.KID: the hero's daughter from the reference sheet (girl about seven, two braids, purple t-shirt, denim shorts)

1: pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays, around the giant steel leg of an offshore oil platform
He hangs in the water next to a huge rusty steel leg of an oil platform, one gloved hand on the steel, a soft beam from his helmet lamp.
Close-up of his face behind the helmet faceplate, eyes wide, a few small bubbles.
Far view: a tiny diver beside the giant platform legs that rise up into the hazy water.
Above the water at dawn: an offshore oil platform and a small dive barge on a calm sea. No people.
2: A neat collage of five small vignettes on white, no people: an oil platform, a pipeline on the seabed, a bridge pier in water, a dam wall, the hull of a ship.
Close-up of a cracked, rusty steel beam underwater, small fish nearby. No people.
The hero in his diving gear welds on a bridge pier underwater with a bright small arc; pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays.
A smartphone screen showing a dramatic video thumbnail of a diver with a red warning triangle icon, no text, no numbers.
3: The instructor stands at the edge of a deep training pool blowing his whistle while five students in black wetsuits sit on the edge, all clearly different people; the hero (in a black wetsuit, no helmet) sits among them.
Close-up of a bench with thick training binders, a coil of rope and a scuffed yellow training helmet. No text.
The hero (in his navy t-shirt) looks wide-eyed at a long paper bill held in both hands, blank paper with only grey lines, no numbers.
A tiny dorm room with a bunk bed, a hot plate and a stack of instant noodle cups. No people.
4: a cloudy indoor training tank with murky green water
The hero in his yellow helmet kneels on the bottom of a murky training tank, feeling a steel plate with both gloved hands, eyes closed.
Close-up of two gloved hands feeling a bolt on a steel plate in murky water.
The instructor watches from above the water surface of the tank, leaning over the edge.
A practice steel plate on a workbench with a few rough, uneven weld beads. No people.
5: a small outdoor graduation at the dive school with a flagless pole and a palm tree
The hero proudly holds up a blank certificate (paper with a gold seal, no text) while the instructor shakes his hand.
Close-up of the blank certificate paper with a gold seal, no text, no letters.
A tall ladder leaning against the side of a dive barge; the hero stands on the very bottom rung looking up.
On a barge deck, the dive supervisor hands the hero a huge coil of orange hose; he staggers under its weight.
6: the deck of a dive barge at sea
The hero, now a tender, pays out a long orange umbilical hose over the side of the barge while bubbles rise from the water; the supervisor watches with her clipboard.
Close-up of his gloved hands feeding the orange umbilical hose over the barge edge.
The hero and the Latino tender help dress a different diver (an older white man with a red beard) into a yellow helmet on a bench.
Bubbles rising and breaking on the sea surface beside the barge hull. No people.
7: a cramped cabin on a work barge at night
The hero lies awake in a narrow bunk in a small cabin with three other bunks; other men sleep in them, all clearly different; a lamp hangs tilted as the barge rolls.
Close-up of his tired face on the pillow, eyes open.
A work barge on rough grey sea at night under a cloudy sky. No people.
The hero leans over the barge rail looking seasick while the Latino tender pats his back.
8: the deck of a dive barge on a sunny morning
The supervisor points at the hero with her pen; he looks surprised and excited, hands raised.
Close-up of the supervisor's face under her cap with the headset, a small smile.
The hero grins and punches the air with one fist.
The yellow diving helmet waiting on a bench in the sun next to a coiled orange hose. No people.
9: the deck of a dive barge
The hero sits on a bench in his black hot-water suit while the Latino tender lowers the heavy yellow helmet onto his head.
Close-up of a hot-water hose connected to a valve on the suit at his hip, a little steam rising.
The hero in full gear steps off the edge of the barge feet first toward the water.
A boxy water heater machine on deck with hoses running to the side of the barge. No people.
10: a vertical column of sea water, bright near the surface and dimmer green below, fading to white at the edges
The hero descends along a vertical rope line, small bubbles rising from his helmet, the light fading below him.
Close-up of his gloved hand sliding down the rope line.
Seen from below: his small dark shape against the bright surface far above.
Bubbles rising toward a bright sea surface. No people.
11: pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays
The hero feels along a steel beam with both gloved hands, eyes closed behind the faceplate.
Close-up of gloved fingertips tracing a thin crack in the steel.
A dim beam from his helmet lamp lights only a small circle of murky water around the beam.
The hero with his faceplate close to the steel, squinting.
12: a small dive-control shack on the barge deck
The supervisor sits at a small console wearing her headset, talking, watching a monitor that shows a blurry greenish underwater view.
Close-up of the monitor showing a blurry green view of gloved hands on steel. No text.
The Latino tender and the supervisor both stare at the monitor, tense.
Several crew members on the barge deck stand frozen and silent, looking at the water. All clearly different people.
13: pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays
The hero welds a seam on a steel pipe with a bright white-blue arc; a pocket of gas bubbles and steam boils around the arc, the brightest thing in the water.
Close-up of the welding electrode holder (a stinger) in his gloved hand, insulated grip.
Far view: one tiny bright spark of light in the vast pale water.
Close-up of the glowing weld spot with bubbles streaming up. No hands, no people.
14: The supervisor speaks into her headset with her hand on the lever of a big red electrical knife switch on the wall.
Close-up of her hand gripping the knife switch lever.
Underwater, the hero holds the welding rod carefully away from his body, the arc not yet lit; pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays.
Thick welding cables running from a welding machine on deck over the side of the barge. No people.
15: a small dry welding habitat on the seabed: a box chamber built around a pipeline, filled with air, water only at the floor
Inside the dry habitat the hero kneels and welds the pipeline in air, wearing a breathing mask instead of the big helmet.
Close-up of a clean, shiny, even weld bead on a pipe.

Outside view: the habitat box on the seabed around the pipeline, bubbles escaping from its top; pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays. No people visible.
Two weld samples side by side on a bench: one cracked and brittle, one smooth and even. No people.
16: the small mess room of the barge
The hero scrolls his phone at a table in the mess, frowning; the Latino tender sits opposite eating soup.
Close-up of a phone screen with a red warning triangle and a skull icon, no text, no numbers.
The Latino tender laughs and shakes his head, spoon in hand.
The supervisor in the doorway shrugs with her clipboard.
17: A simple bar chart drawn on white: one tall red bar and one very short grey bar, no numbers, no text.
Many tiny simple person icons in neat rows on white, all grey except one red. No text.
A snowy harbor in Alaska with a small dive boat and mountains. No people.
A small memorial wreath on a wooden dock. No people.
18: pale green-blue water that fades to white at the edges, light and airy, soft light rays, near a large dam intake grate
Swirling lines of water rush toward a big intake grate at the base of a dam; the hero stays back at a safe distance, held by his taut umbilical, wary.
Close-up of swirl lines pulling leaves and debris into the grate. No people.
On the barge deck the supervisor and the Latino tender go through a checklist on her clipboard (lines only, no text).
An orange hose tangled around a broken pipe on the seabed. No people.
19: A plastic soda bottle being opened, a burst of fizzing bubbles shooting up. No people.
A simple drawing of a blood vessel with tiny bubbles inside it. No text.

A diagram-like drawing of a diver's silhouette with a few small bubbles marked at the knees and elbows. No text.
20: a column of sea water fading to white
The hero hangs on the rope line at a stop, arm wrapped around the rope, waiting calmly, looking up at the faint bright surface.
Close-up of his calm face behind the faceplate, eyes closed, breathing slowly.
On deck, the hero sits inside a white steel decompression chamber, seen through its small round window.
On the barge deck the Latino tender and other crew eat dinner at a table, a white chamber behind them.
21: the inside of a cramped steel saturation living chamber
The hero, in a dark t-shirt and shorts, sits on a bunk inside a cramped round steel chamber with two other divers (a bald white man and a young East Asian man), a tiny round window.
Close-up of the round porthole of the chamber seen from outside, with the hero's face looking out through it.
A cutaway drawing of a ship with steel chambers inside and a diving bell hanging on a cable under it. No people.
A tiny fold-down table in the chamber with playing cards and three mugs. No people.
22: the inside of the saturation chamber
The hero and the two other divers laugh hard, faces scrunched, as if their voices sound silly. No speech bubbles, no text.
Close-up of a food tray sliding through a small round airlock door in the steel wall.
A yellow diving bell being lowered on a cable from the side of a ship into the sea. No people.
The hero alone inside a small round yellow diving bell, wearing his yellow helmet, sitting ready above an open hatch in the floor.
23: the inside of the saturation chamber
The hero lies on his bunk staring at the curved steel ceiling, bored and patient.
Close-up of a small whiteboard with eight tally marks drawn in marker. No numbers, no text.
The heavy round hatch of the chamber, closed and bolted. No people.
The hero finally climbs out of the chamber hatch, blinking at daylight.

Close-up of a blank pay envelope in his hands. No text.
An oil platform on the horizon at sunset. No people.
The hero zips up a big duffel bag on his bunk.

A kitchen table with a birthday cake with candles and one empty chair. No people.

Close-up of the hero's proud, tired face.
